dialogue.origin: 今日は、どのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: How can I help you today?

dialogue.origin: 主人といるのがしんどくて、毎日家に帰るのが気が重いんです
dialogue.content: Being with my husband is exhausting, and I dread coming home every day.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは、かなり辛そうですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That sounds very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は普段から会話などしてくれますか
dialogue.content: Does your husband usually engage in conversation with you?

dialogue.origin: 普段一緒にいる時は、普通に話しています。多少気は使いますが。
dialogue.content: When we're together, we talk normally. I do have to be somewhat careful, though.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。会話ができているのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you are able to have conversations.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何か機嫌が悪くなる時があるのですか
dialogue.content: Are there times when he gets in a bad mood?

dialogue.origin: 自分が納得できない時は機嫌が悪くなる、、というか、何度も同じことを繰り返して話をするんです
dialogue.content: When he can't accept something, he gets into a bad mood... or rather, he keeps repeating the same thing over and over.

dialogue.origin: 自分が納得できるまで。
dialogue.content: Until he's satisfied.

dialogue.origin: 他の人となら、会話のキャッチボールができるのですが、
dialogue.content: With other people, I can have a back-and-forth conversation,

dialogue.origin: 主人とはなしていると、主人は同じことの繰り返しで、
dialogue.content: but when I talk with my husband, he just repeats the same thing.

dialogue.origin: 繰り返してることを突っ込むと、
dialogue.content: and if I point out he's repeating himself,

dialogue.origin: 私の方が話を理解していないと。
dialogue.content: he says I'm the one who doesn't understand.

dialogue.origin: はい。そうなんですね。それは気持ちが通じていない感じですか
dialogue.content: I see. Does it feel like you're not getting through to each other?

dialogue.origin: 通じていないというか、
dialogue.content: It’s not exactly that...

dialogue.origin: 同じことを何度も聞くって辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: It must be hard to hear the same thing over and over.

dialogue.origin: おそらく主人もわかってはいると思うのですが
dialogue.content: I think my husband probably does understand,

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 自分の思うように納得しない限り
dialogue.content: but unless things make sense to him in his own way,

dialogue.origin: 認めないという感じです
dialogue.content: it's like he won't accept it.

dialogue.origin: 例えば
dialogue.content: For example,

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、そういうことなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see... so that's how it is.

dialogue.origin: はい。たとえば、、、
dialogue.content: Yes. For example...?

dialogue.origin: 明らかに主人に原因があったのに、
dialogue.content: Even when it’s clearly his fault,

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 世の中の普通の人はそれで通じるけど、自分にはそれが通じないから
dialogue.content: he'll say something like, 'That might work for ordinary people, but it doesn't work for me,'

dialogue.origin: 自分は悪くない
dialogue.content: 'so I'm not at fault.'

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... so that’s what happens.

dialogue.origin: みたいな事をいうんです。自分は普通の考えとは違うと。
dialogue.content: He says things like that. That his way of thinking is different from ordinary people.

dialogue.origin: ご自分でも何か気付いていらっしゃる、、、？
dialogue.content: Is he aware of it himself...?

dialogue.origin: 私ですか？
dialogue.content: Me?

dialogue.origin: いえ、ご主人です。
dialogue.content: No, your husband.

dialogue.origin: おそらく
dialogue.content: Probably.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: わかってはいると思うんです。自分が悪い事も。
dialogue.content: I think he does know—even when he’s in the wrong.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: ただ、普通じゃない？それ。
dialogue.content: But he's like, 'Isn't that normal?'

dialogue.origin: みたいな感じで
dialogue.content: Something like that.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと価値観が違うというか、、
dialogue.content: It's like... our values are a bit different.

dialogue.origin: はあー、、、なるほど、、、
dialogue.content: Ah... I see...

dialogue.origin: 普通に会話できないんです。
dialogue.content: We can't have a normal conversation.

dialogue.origin: 主人は
dialogue.content: My husband is...

dialogue.origin: 器用な人で、
dialogue.content: a capable person,

dialogue.origin: 家事や料理とか手伝ってくれる事もあるんです
dialogue.content: and he sometimes helps with housework and cooking,

dialogue.origin: 私よりも
dialogue.content: better than I do, even,

dialogue.origin: なんでもできる
dialogue.content: he can do almost anything.

dialogue.origin: そこはありがたいのですが、
dialogue.content: I'm grateful for that, but...

dialogue.origin: はい。そうなんですね。なんでも出来てしまう、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, I see. He can do just about everything...

dialogue.origin: たまに、なんでそれができないのか理解できない
dialogue.content: Sometimes he’ll say he can’t understand why someone can’t do something,

dialogue.origin: みたいにいうこともあり、
dialogue.content: he says things like that,

dialogue.origin: それは私だけでなく
dialogue.content: and not just to me,

dialogue.origin: 世間一般にも
dialogue.content: but to people in general.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いろいろ出来てしまう、、、そんな中でも、苦労はあるのですね
dialogue.content: He can do so many things... and yet, there are still hardships, aren't there.

dialogue.origin: 苦労なんですかね、、
dialogue.content: I’m not sure if "struggles" is the right word...

dialogue.origin: ちょっとしたズレからなんでしょうが、、、
dialogue.content: It might come from a small misalignment, but...

dialogue.origin: 普段は普通に会話もできるんです。でも、カッと熱くなった時が大変で
dialogue.content: Usually we can talk normally. But when he flares up, it’s difficult.

dialogue.origin: 機嫌が悪くなると、何時間も同じ話をします
dialogue.content: When he’s in a bad mood, he’ll talk about the same thing for hours.

dialogue.origin: なので、
dialogue.content: So,

dialogue.origin: ちょっと気を使う感じなんです。
dialogue.content: I feel like I have to walk on eggshells.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね！何時間もですか、、、それは逃げたくなりますね、、、
dialogue.content: I see! For hours? That would make anyone want to escape...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気疲れて話したくんないですね、、、
dialogue.content: It must be emotionally draining, making you not want to talk...

dialogue.origin: 疲れます
dialogue.content: It’s exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 正直離婚も考えましたが、
dialogue.content: Honestly, I’ve even considered divorce,

dialogue.origin: お金のことや子供のことなど、いろいろ考えるとなかなか、、
dialogue.content: but when I think about money, our child, and everything else, it's difficult...

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんすね。離婚まで追い詰められて、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, I see. You've been driven to the point of considering divorce...

dialogue.origin: お子さんは何人ですか
dialogue.content: How many children do you have?

dialogue.origin: １人です
dialogue.content: One.

dialogue.origin: 実は子供もあまり父親のことが好きではないんです
dialogue.content: Actually, our child doesn't really like their father either.

dialogue.origin: でも、主人は子供は大事にしています
dialogue.content: But my husband does cherish our child.

dialogue.origin: ただ、やはり度が行きすぎる時があるんです
dialogue.content: It’s just that he sometimes goes too far.

dialogue.origin: 子を思ってだとは思うのですが
dialogue.content: I think he does it out of concern for our child, but...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。度が過ぎるとどのようになりますか
dialogue.content: I see. What happens when he goes too far?

dialogue.origin: 例えば、休み期間中の宿題をやってるって言ってたのに終わらせていなくて
dialogue.content: For example, our child said they were doing their homework over the vacation but hadn't finished it,

dialogue.origin: カッとなり、朝5時までやらせていました
dialogue.content: he lost his temper and made them do it until five in the morning.

dialogue.origin: ずっと横について
dialogue.content: He stayed right beside them the whole time.

dialogue.origin: それでは、お子さんもかわいそうですね
dialogue.content: That must have been very hard on your child.

dialogue.origin: 確かに子供もダメなところがありましたが、
dialogue.content: It's true our child was also at fault, but...

dialogue.origin: 嫌がる気持ちわかりますよ。
dialogue.content: I can understand why they would resent that.

dialogue.origin: 可哀想でした
dialogue.content: I felt so sorry for them.

dialogue.origin: 私も朝まで起きていましたが、
dialogue.content: I stayed up until morning too,

dialogue.origin: ちょっとやりすぎな気がして
dialogue.content: and I felt it was going a little too far.

dialogue.origin: はい、おっしゃるとうりです
dialogue.content: Yes, I agree.

dialogue.origin: でも、次の日は子供と話をしているゲームを一緒にしたりと、もしかすると主人も反省するところが
dialogue.content: But the next day, he played games with the child while talking, so maybe he reflected on it,

dialogue.origin: あったのかもしれません
dialogue.content: He might have.

dialogue.origin: でも、問題集を買ってきて、やらせています。
dialogue.content: Still, he bought workbooks and is making our child do them.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、ご主人は、一つのことにこだわるタイプな感じですね
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like your husband is the type to fixate on one thing.

dialogue.origin: 強要まではいかないですが、子供も怒られるからやらないと、、と、少しずつやっています
dialogue.content: It's not quite forcing them, but our child is doing it little by little, thinking, 'I have to do it or I'll get yelled at.'

dialogue.origin: こだわるタイプ、、なのかな。なぜできないのかが、理解できないといいます
dialogue.content: The fixating type... I guess so. He says he can't understand why someone can't do something.

dialogue.origin: 一生懸命なことは、他人には強制的に感じますよね
dialogue.content: When someone is very intense about something, it can feel coercive to others.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なんだか考えが自分中心な感じです
dialogue.content: His thinking seems very self-centered.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、、、そんな感じしますね。お子さんは、そんななか
dialogue.content: Yes... it does seem that way. And your child, in the midst of all that,

dialogue.origin: 学校は楽しくいってますか
dialogue.content: are they enjoying school?

dialogue.origin: 学校は行ってます
dialogue.content: They are going to school.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです。
dialogue.content: That's good to hear.

dialogue.origin: じゃあ、お子さんはとてもがんばりやさんですね
dialogue.content: Then, your child must be a very hard worker.

dialogue.origin: そして、お母様も。。。
dialogue.content: And you as well, as their mother...

dialogue.origin: 子供なりに、頑張ってると思います。が、自分は
dialogue.content: I think they’re doing their best in their own way. But as for me...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 頭悪いしできない人間だからみたいなことは
dialogue.content: things like, 'I'm stupid and incapable,'

dialogue.origin: 子供が言うようになり、
dialogue.content: my child has started saying,

dialogue.origin: ちょっと心配しています。
dialogue.content: and I'm a little worried.

dialogue.origin: なので、
dialogue.content: So,

dialogue.origin: 毎日主人に、今日いる？って聞くようにもなりました
dialogue.content: I've started asking my husband every day, "Are you going to be home today?"

dialogue.origin: 主人がいるのが子供もしんどいようで
dialogue.content: It seems being with their father is hard on our child too.

dialogue.origin: いない日はとてもリラックスしている感じです
dialogue.content: On days he’s not home, they seem much more relaxed.

dialogue.origin: まあ、、、、それは神経によくないですね、、、お子さんの口調にでてしまいましたか、、、
dialogue.content: Oh... that's not good for one's nerves... It's even started to show in what your child says...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いないとリラックスできる、、、となると。
dialogue.content: If they can relax only when he’s not there...

dialogue.origin: 今後、お子さんの心が心配ですね
dialogue.content: I'm concerned about your child’s emotional well-being going forward.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: これから反抗期とかもくるだろうし
dialogue.content: They'll be going through their rebellious phase soon, too.

dialogue.origin: お母様とは、たくさんお話しされているようですから、、、
dialogue.content: It sounds like you talk a lot with your child, though...

dialogue.origin: 家でリラックスできないのは可哀想です
dialogue.content: It’s sad that they can’t relax at home.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですよね。家がしっかりしていないと、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. If home isn't a secure place...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なので、お母様が心のよりどころですね
dialogue.content: So you are their emotional anchor.

dialogue.origin: 学校で嫌なことがあって、家も嫌になると、居場所がなくなりますよね
dialogue.content: If something bad happens at school and home also feels bad, they’d have nowhere to belong.

dialogue.origin: 主人は仕事で家で仕事することも多いので
dialogue.content: My husband often works from home,

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんですね。在宅ですか、、、
dialogue.content: I see—so he works from home...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 週の半分は家で仕事しています
dialogue.content: He works from home about half the week.

dialogue.origin: でも、洗濯たたんだり、夕飯を作ったりはしてくれるんです
dialogue.content: But, he does things like fold the laundry and make dinner.

dialogue.origin: 普段は良いパパですよね、外から見ると

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。外からは全くわからない、、、それは息が詰まる日も、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true. No one would know from the outside... There must be days when it feels suffocating...

dialogue.origin: あります
dialogue.content: There are.

dialogue.origin: 周りにはだれか相談できる人はいますか
dialogue.content: Is there anyone around you that you can talk to?

dialogue.origin: 身内とか、、、
dialogue.content: Family, for example...

dialogue.origin: 友達には話して、、というか、お互い愚痴は言い合ったりします。解決にはならないですが。
dialogue.content: I talk to friends, or rather, we vent to each other. It doesn't solve anything, though.

dialogue.content: I've also consulted my in-laws.

dialogue.origin: 正直、
dialogue.content: Honestly,

dialogue.content: I even talked with them about divorce.

dialogue.origin: はい。なんと？
dialogue.content: I see. And what did they say?

dialogue.content: But my in-laws treat me like their own daughter,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: やはり、なんだかんだ主人のことも大事で
dialogue.content: and of course, they care about their son too,

dialogue.origin: 孫の今後のこととか考えると
dialogue.content: and when they think about their grandchild’s future,

dialogue.content: they were against divorce.

dialogue.origin: お金の面とかなにかあれば、出来るだけサポートするからって
dialogue.content: They said they would support me as much as possible if there were any issues with money or anything.

dialogue.origin: 離婚に反対、、、でも理解はしている。有りがたいことですが、、、

dialogue.content: Yes, they help me in many ways, and I’m grateful. They always check in on me.

dialogue.content: That's because you are such a wonderful daughter-in-law.

dialogue.content: Thank you. It can be tiring, but they treat me so well, and that's part of the reason I'm holding back on a divorce.

dialogue.content: I see. You're trying so hard. And it feels like they really understand that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: Let me summarize what I’ve heard so far.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: ご主人が、よく料理を手伝ってはくれるけど、子どもに対してもきつくあたる。
dialogue.content: Your husband helps a lot with cooking, but he can be harsh with your child.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 会話は出来るけれど、気持ちが通じないといつまでも自分の意見をいいとうす。
dialogue.content: You can have conversations, but when he feels he's not being understood, he will keep insisting on his own opinion endlessly.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じです、、
dialogue.content: That’s about right...

dialogue.origin: 子どもも父親の事を嫌がっている。
dialogue.content: Your child also dislikes their father.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 義理のお母様はよく理解はしているが、似たもの同士だから、相談者さんは気疲れる。

dialogue.origin: でも、それらを分かってか、とても良くしてくださる。
dialogue.content: Still, perhaps because they recognize this, your in-laws are very kind to you.

dialogue.origin: 疲れますが、ほんとにいい義父母です
dialogue.content: It’s tiring, but they really are good in-laws.

dialogue.origin: 離婚を踏みとどまれるのは、義理の父母のお陰、、、と思っている

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: Shall we think about it together?

dialogue.content: I wish I could just have a normal, ordinary conversation with my husband.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、まず会話ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, conversation is the first step, isn't it.

dialogue.origin: 家に帰ってもリラックスできるといいのですが、、
dialogue.content: I wish I could relax when I come home...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.content: Time for just the two of you... a shared topic of conversation.

dialogue.origin: 主人もなんだかんだ仕事が忙しく。
dialogue.content: And my husband is busy with work one way or another.

dialogue.origin: あ、でも
dialogue.content: Oh, but...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.content: Sometimes at night, the three of us...

dialogue.content: we play games together.

dialogue.origin: はい。いいですね！
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s great!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ゲーム、もりあがりますね
dialogue.content: Games can be really exciting, can't they.

dialogue.origin: はい。ゲームをする時は子供も楽しそうです
dialogue.content: Yes. When we play games, our child seems to have fun too.

dialogue.origin: しかも、お子さんも喜ぶ！
dialogue.content: And your child enjoys it too!

dialogue.origin: そうですね(^^)
dialogue.content: That's true. (^^)

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、でも、三人でできることですよね！
dialogue.content: I see... but it’s something the three of you can do together!

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.origin: 凄いことにきずけましたね！
dialogue.content: You’ve realized something really valuable!

dialogue.origin: ぜひ、三人の楽しい時間を大切に、、、
dialogue.content: Please cherish those enjoyable moments as a family of three...

dialogue.origin: 子供もゲームの時は楽しいみたいですので、時間ある時はこれからもやります
dialogue.content: My child seems to enjoy game time, so we'll keep doing it when we have time.

dialogue.origin: 相談者さんは、見守っていける心のあるかたですね。
dialogue.content: You are someone with the heart to watch over and support them.

dialogue.origin: すばらしいです。
dialogue.content: That’s wonderful.

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうか、、ありがとうございます
